items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So after we did it, made the record, and made a big hit

ctx.x: Tell me about your time with Gerry Mulligan.

Mulligan was a great experience. When I first started doing mumbles, it was right after I had been doing it on “The Tonight Show,” and Gerry scowled every time I’d ask him to do it. So after we did it, made the record, and made a big hit – it’s still providing nice royalties for me – every time I would see Gerry, he’d say, “Just think. I was stupid enough to not claim that. I could have had that on my own.”
How did he use the flugelhorn? Was that – talk about how the flugelhorn was played within that.
